name: com.kwai.opensdk.sdk.openapi.KwaiRouterActivity
description: When KwaiSocial’s Kwai OpenSDK invokes this redirect, it opens the host app’s launch screen if the SDK has not been initialized, then closes. This provides a fallback for returning to the app.
disableEffect: This fallback cannot reopen the app for that Kwai handoff, and the associated return flow may not resume.
